user.title: Herald Notification Center
user.description: Configure Herald notification routing and optional text generation.

abort.invalid_quiet_hours: Enter a valid time in HH:MM format (00:00–23:59).
abort.single_instance_allowed: Only one Herald instance is supported.

error.invalid_time: Enter a valid time in HH:MM format (00:00–23:59).
error.invalid_selection: Select an available item from the list.
error.invalid_value: Check the format and allowed values for this field.
error.invalid_host: For OpenAI-compatible APIs, use an HTTPS base URL, optionally ending in /v1.

init.title: Herald settings
init.description: Choose a section. Saving closes this dialog and changes only the fields you edited; other settings are preserved.

quiet_hours.title: Quiet hours
quiet_hours.description: Set the quiet-hours interval in Home Assistant local time. Channel settings and notification rules determine which deliveries are allowed.

data_description.start: Use HH:MM, from 00:00 to 23:59. An interval can cross midnight.
data_description.end: Use HH:MM, from 00:00 to 23:59. An interval can cross midnight.

ai.title: Text generation
ai.description: Choose Ollama or an OpenAI-compatible API. Saving settings does not enable AI or test the connection. Use the Herald AI switch separately. The API key is never shown again; leave it blank to keep the stored key.

maintenance.title: Maintenance mode
maintenance.description: Choose an optional external entity for maintenance mode. Maintenance is active when this entity or the Herald maintenance switch is on.

data_description.maintenance_mode_entity: Entity ID whose on state activates maintenance. Leave empty to remove this external link; the Herald maintenance switch remains available.

channel_select.title: Delivery channels
channel_select.description: Choose one existing channel to edit. Creating channels or configuring provider credentials is not available here.

channel.title: Channel: {channel_name}
channel.description: Change the settings for this channel only. Enabled means the channel may be used; it does not confirm delivery.

data_description.enabled: A disabled channel is excluded from ordinary delivery. An explicit authorized channel test can bypass this setting. Global restrictions and notification rules still apply.
data_description.min_level: Ordinary notifications below this threshold are skipped. An explicit authorized channel test can bypass the channel threshold; other restrictions still apply.

flow_select.title: Notification flows
flow_select.description: Choose one existing notification flow to edit its repeat limits and summary persona.

flow.title: Flow: {flow_name}
flow.description: Set defaults for this flow. A notification rule can override its cooldown, and a request can override duplicate suppression. Saving does not enable summaries.

data_description.summary_personality: An empty value removes the summary override. The request persona, flow persona or default persona is then used.
data_description.cooldown_seconds: Skip notifications during this interval after the last delivery in the flow. 0 disables this limit. Notifications are not deferred.
data_description.dedup_window_seconds: Skip matching repeated events within this window. 0 disables this filter. Notifications are not deferred.

abort.no_channels: No channels are available to edit. Check the channel configuration in Herald.
abort.no_flows: No notification flows are available to edit.
abort.channel_unavailable: This channel is no longer available. Reopen settings and choose an available channel.
abort.flow_unavailable: This flow is no longer available. Reopen settings and choose an available flow.

preview_notification_policy.name: Preview notification rule
preview_notification_policy.description: Preview a draft without saving or sending. Scenarios change routing context; real states and time remain current.

set_notification_policy.name: Set notification rule
set_notification_policy.description: Update selected fields of a notification rule. Omitted fields retain their saved values.

users.name: Personal message recipients
users.description: Person IDs; null inherits, an empty list blocks all delivery. Common channels and room audio remain shared.

target_room.name: Room for voice and TV
target_room.description: Known room name; null inherits. No fallback to another room.

presence.name: Presence condition
presence.description: Always, only when someone is home, or only when nobody is home.

quiet_hours.name: During quiet hours
quiet_hours.description: Inherit common restrictions, keep eligible text channels, or skip. Does not defer delivery.

configuration_check.name: Check notification configuration
configuration_check.description: Inspect local channel settings, services, entities and restrictions without sending, changing settings or invoking AI. Provider credentials and connectivity are not tested.
